visual_target: commercial casual-strategy construction game, polished 2.5D chibi-realistic 3D, adult-friendly, bright but credible Korean construction-site atmosphere

global_rules.recognition_rule: Every character must remain identifiable with the name label hidden by at least three of: silhouette, face, age, helmet, clothing, prop, pose.
global_rules.proportion_rule: Use one shared stylized world scale, but vary shoulder width, height impression, head/face shape and stance. Do not reuse one base body for the full cast.
global_rules.helmet_rule: Helmets may share realistic site colors, but helmet color alone must never be the primary identity cue. No pseudo-text or gibberish marks.
global_rules.face_rule: No two characters may share the same eye shape + jaw shape + nose/mouth combination.
global_rules.pose_rule: Default map pose must communicate job function before reading the role label.
global_rules.tone_rule: Cute and approachable, not childish or slapstick. Accidents and hazards remain credible.
global_rules.render_rule: Portrait and map sprite must clearly depict the same person, clothing family and signature prop.

player.silhouette: medium height, compact athletic build, centered confident stance
player.face: soft V-shaped face, focused almond eyes, dark low ponytail with side fringe visible beneath the helmet; clearly different from every male NPC
player.helmet: clean white safety helmet with a thin blue stripe and one small NEW PSI mark
player.clothing: blue safety jacket or vest over dark workwear, neat practical styling
player.default_pose: tablet in one hand, other hand ready to point or signal stop

kang_taesik.silhouette: short-to-medium, very broad shoulders, heavy sturdy torso
kang_taesik.face: square weathered face, thick eyebrows, prominent moustache with short grizzled beard
kang_taesik.clothing: charcoal work jacket, orange reflective vest, heavy gloves
kang_taesik.signature_prop: tape measure clipped to belt and rolled work glove/tool pouch
kang_taesik.default_pose: one arm pointing toward the workface, feet planted wide

yoon_sungho.silhouette: tall, muscular forearms, tapered athletic torso
yoon_sungho.face: longer angular face, narrow eyes, short dark stubble; no moustache-heavy Kang look
yoon_sungho.helmet: mustard-yellow helmet with dark chin strap
yoon_sungho.clothing: brown/khaki heavy workwear with black forearm guards and gloves
yoon_sungho.signature_prop: short bundled rebar sample / rebar hook
yoon_sungho.default_pose: one forearm resting against rebar, other hand checking alignment

lee_jaehoon.silhouette: tall and slim, long limbs, upright office-to-field posture
lee_jaehoon.face: clean-shaven youthful rectangular face, straight eyebrows, smaller eyes, neat dark hair
lee_jaehoon.clothing: blue field jacket, white or pale shirt, slim dark work pants
lee_jaehoon.default_pose: drawings under one arm while checking schedule with the other hand

lim_junho.silhouette: shorter, slim youthful frame, slightly inward shoulders
lim_junho.face: round youthful face, wide eyes, small nose, visibly younger than all supervisors
lim_junho.helmet: bright yellow helmet slightly large-looking on him
lim_junho.clothing: green high-visibility vest over dark T-shirt/workwear
lim_junho.signature_prop: compact radio and small tool bag
lim_junho.default_pose: radio held close while glancing toward a supervisor or hazard
lim_junho.expression: earnest, observant, slightly hesitant but capable of courage

choi_minseok.silhouette: lean athletic body, arms held wide for signaling, dynamic open stance
choi_minseok.face: triangular lively face, expressive smile lines, energetic eyes
choi_minseok.clothing: bright orange reflective signal vest over black workwear
choi_minseok.signature_prop: pair of red illuminated signal wands
choi_minseok.default_pose: both signal wands clearly raised in a crane-hand-signal posture

seo_jeongmin.silhouette: slim medium height, straight reserved posture

seo_jeongmin.clothing: dark navy blazer-style site jacket, muted vest, clean trousers
seo_jeongmin.default_pose: clipboard against chest, pen raised while checking a detail
seo_jeongmin.expression: precise, skeptical, calm rather than hostile

oh_seungjae.silhouette: medium-tall, slightly broad management build, one shoulder often angled as if taking a call
oh_seungjae.face: broad cheekbones, slightly tired eyes, defined jaw, clean-shaven
oh_seungjae.helmet: white helmet with dark blue band
oh_seungjae.clothing: navy manager field jacket over light shirt, radio clipped at chest
